description: Plan JSON-LD schema for a URL or markdown page without a provider call. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

include_jsonld.description: Include proposed JSON-LD structured-data examples in the plan when true; this does not publish them. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

page_markdown.description: Page content supplied as Markdown instead of fetching url; provide page content or an accessible URL. Type: String. Minimum: 80 characters. Maximum: 50000 characters. Optional; no client default.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "auto", "article", "blog_post", "landing_page", "product", "software", "local_business", "faq", "how_to". Default: "auto".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

url.description: Absolute web page URL to analyze; use an http:// or https:// URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_content_schema_plan
title: AgentSEO Content Schema Plan
